scope: Offline first-party feasibility metadata for this panel exact1.50.10 only. No hardware/native calls, no live file listing, no font extraction, no vendor code/byte arrays, no old frozen input or network ABI evidence changes.

resource_mount.boot_intent: GPT font partition10MiB if fallback repartition path is entered; when /dev/font exists mountROMFS at/font, otherwise mountedfont availability is not assured. This is boot intent, not verified currentGPT/mount/file state.
resource_mount.resource_medium: MMC font partition provided through existing VFS, separate from this16MiB NOR backup. TTF bytes/file size and currentmount remain unverified.

lv_freetype_init.evidence: Original factory call(128,2,0) followed by errorbranch; native code writes globalcache state.
lv_freetype_init.use_limit: Never call global init/destroy as incidental drawer setup while original GUI remainsactive.

lv_ft_font_init_cache.status: Binary initializer/layout and original callers match pinned public LVGL source; not executed or admitted as runtime ABI by this analysis.

get_glyph_descriptor.status: Callback installed at font+0; full descriptor/configuration ABI and runtime correctness are not independently admitted.

get_glyph_bitmap.status: Callback installed atfont+4; returns currentsharedcache glyph, not lifetime-stable independent image.

native_glyph_API_candidates.font_manager: Original manager/path/check/init/reference-count code exists. Complete manager API and ownership ABI not resolved; avoid guessing a public entry or using stale originalGUI font pointers.

routes.resource_only_reuse: Can request existing MiSans TTF through native VFS/font loader after currentmount/file and callback ABI verification; this avoids embedding a full font. Not a screen-drawingAPI by itself.
routes.LVGL_widget_route: Font can style native LVGL widgets if mutations, font creation/reference management, rendering and release execute through the original GUI task/lock. Current drawer directcanvas bypasses LVGL widget rendering.
routes.direct_canvas_route: Can rasterize native glyph descriptors/coverage then blend into ownedcanvas, but descriptor+bitmap pair and copying must be serialized with originalGUI fontcache operations; release cache lock only after copying/blending coverage, preserve fontreferences. A separate FT library could provide independent cache but needs additional verifiedloader/allocation/lifetimeABI and codebudget.
routes.current_image_protocol: Host decodes image to fixed480x320RGB565, device receives pixels only. Incomingimage needs no TTF. DefaultIP currently uses compact embeddeddigits; this artifact does not change renderer or install nativefont calls.

verification_before_native_font_use: Read-only establish current/font mount and file availability; do not runrcS/fsck/mkgpt tocheck.
Confirm exact nativefont/descriptor ABI and originalGUI execution/lock boundary in thecurrent installedbaseline.
Exercise one ASCII glyph through a boundedreviewedGUI-thread path, copy coverage whilecache remainsowned, then validatefallback/missingglyph handling.
Account for memory, lifetime and failurepaths; do not reinitialize/destroy shared originalFreeType/cache or retain a mutable globalglyphbuffer betweenrendercalls.

semantic_windows.name: factory_font_setup
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Original factory GUI initializes FreeType then sets MiSans path, weight22/40, memoryNULL and calls native font initializer. Factory container is already repurposed; evidence does not authorize replay.

semantic_windows.name: lv_freetype_global_init
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Allocates native FT library/cache structures and writes shared global pointers. Do not reinitialize or destroy while original GUI uses them.

semantic_windows.name: font_face_requester
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Native face loader uses stored path or memory and emits FT_New_Face error; pointer layout and call flow agree with LVGL FreeType cache variant.

semantic_windows.name: glyph_descriptor_entry
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Font glyph callback gets descriptor viafont+0x14, looks up shared font size/cache, receives Unicode current/next args. API candidate only.

semantic_windows.name: glyph_cache_path
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Shared charmap/image cache lookups plus LRU/list mutations. Independent glyph calls are not concurrency-safe by default.

semantic_windows.name: glyph_style_and_global_state
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Writes glyph dimensions/8-bit coverage information and current_face global for styled glyphs.

semantic_windows.name: font_initializer
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Allocates52 bytes, copies lv_ft_info-like fields, saves shared name reference, initializes font callbacks and outputsfont atinfo+12; returns1 on success,0 onfailure.

semantic_windows.name: glyph_bitmap_callback
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Returns buffer from shared current_face at0x384fce10 or current image glyph at0x384fcee8, rather than an independent immutable per-font bitmap.

semantic_windows.name: font_manager_path_creation
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Builds default /font base directory from root plus %s/font and allocates manager; comparison source names identify original font_manager.

semantic_windows.name: font_manager_file_and_init
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Builds %s/%s.ttf path, checks file access, calls native font initializer, reports requested name/weight/style on failure.

semantic_windows.name: font_manager_return_delete
semantic_windows.semantic_summary: Updates reference count and name/cache lists; manager font lifetime cannot be bypassed by borrowing a pointer indefinitely.
